Delphinium elatum , Ranunculaceae, Candle Larkspur, habitus; Botanical Garden KIT, Karlsruhe, Germany.

Another plant with a colour that seems hard to capture on our (rather cheap) camera. In life it's a really good blue, just touched with purple at the base. These really were the stars of the early sum
